The '''Sisterhood of Ta'fan-jirah''' was an organization that was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the representative of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], had a special relationship with the Sisterhood of Ta'fan-jirah, and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] of Naboo received special considerations on Chandrila as a result.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
